name: @local/markdown-notes-plus
description: Markdown Notes+ editor for Standard Notes with Writing, Source, Task, Outline, and Mind Map projections.

scripts.test:unit: deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-run --no-prompt tests/index.test.ts tests/review-diagnostics.test.ts tests/template-engine.test.ts tests/callouts-and-codeblocks.test.ts tests/smart-paste.test.ts tests/toolbar-wheel.test.ts tests/source-storage-audit.test.ts tests/visual-viewport.test.ts tests/outline-pointer-drag.test.ts tests/recurring-tasks.test.ts tests/extension-manifest.test.ts tests/apk-downloader.test.ts tests/e2e-harness.test.ts tests/vite-manifest-serving.test.ts tests/kanban-model.test.ts tests/kanban-move.test.ts
